name: Peresh
title: Son of Judah and Tamar
summary: Peresh was the son of Judah and Tamar, and twin brother to Serah. He was born under dramatic circumstances where he broke out ahead of his brother, which gave him the name Peresh ('breakthrough'). He is an important figure in Jesus' lineage and is mentioned in several genealogies in the Bible.

keyEvents.title: The Birth of Peresh
keyEvents.description: During the birth, twin brother Serah reached out his hand first, but Peresh broke out ahead of him. The midwife exclaimed: 'What a breakthrough you have made!' Hence the name Peresh.

keyEvents.title: Judah's Sin with Tamar
keyEvents.description: Perez was conceived when Tamar, disguised as a prostitute, slept with Judah because he had not given her his youngest son Shelah as a husband as he had promised.

keyEvents.title: Perez in Jacob's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Perez is mentioned as the son of Judah in the genealogy of Jacob's descendants who went down to Egypt. His sons Hezron and Hamul are also mentioned.

keyEvents.title: Perez in the Book of Ruth
keyEvents.description: In the genealogy at the end of the Book of Ruth, Perez is named as an ancestor of David. The line goes from Perez through Hezron, Ram, Amminadab, Nahshon, Salmon, Boaz, Obed, and Jesse to David.

keyEvents.title: Perez in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: In 1 Chronicles, Perez's lineage is described in detail as part of the genealogy of the tribe of Judah, showing his significance for Israel's history.

keyEvents.title: Perez in Jesus' Lineage
keyEvents.description: Perez is mentioned in the genealogy in the Gospel of Matthew as part of the family tree of Jesus Christ, highlighting his place in salvation history.
